objective: Determine whether dense teacher penalty components retain distinct non-degenerate structure after removing prediction-count and ground-truth-count scale effects.
decision_rule: If both residualized and support-normalized penalty correlations are at most 0.85 and normalized required components remain non-degenerate, allow only a minimal fixed-unit-weight endpoint learnability probe. Otherwise reduce the penalty basis before any model fitting.
claim_boundary: Researcher-adaptive analysis of a locked inner-fit artifact. It reads no new images or split and establishes neither endpoint learnability nor detector gain.
